answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in echo and opal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the wharf graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1044 impostors cost 752 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
